data: ESA / EU Agency for the Space Programme (EUSPA)
Europe's civilian GNSS — ~30 sats, sub-metre positioning
ESA / EUSPA Galileo programme. Civilian-managed (unlike GPS / GLONASS military operators); open + commercial + Public Regulated Service tiers.

Europe's civilian GNSS — 34 satellites have been launched (4 IOV + 30 FOC); 27 operational + 1 commissioning as of May 2026; constellation target is 30 at 23,222 km MEO in 3 orbital planes inclined 56°. First operational service 2016; full operational capability declaration pending ESA/EUSPA official announcement. Unlike GPS (military operator) and GLONASS (military operator), Galileo is managed by EUSPA, an EU civilian agency. Designed for sub-metre positioning with open + commercial + Public Regulated Service tiers. Search and Rescue payload integrated for emergency-beacon detection.

Europe's navigation constellation. 30 operational satellites. Provides more accurate civilian positioning than GPS — 1 metre accuracy commercially available. Controlled by European Commission, not any single nation or military.
